about_the_game:
When I was fishing, I caught a small fish and casually threw it into the water but not success. However, the fish bounced back into the water on its own, so I developed this game.

We will play the role of a fish thrown ashore and try to bounce back into the water.

The basic operation is to accumulate power by long pressing the left mouse button, controlling the magnitude and direction of the force, and then the fish will exert force at the tail to jump, paying attention to avoiding obstacles on the road.
